title: Where the answer is read from decides whether a first-match computation is learnable at all

task.name: query_chase
task.definition: A permutation defines a single cycle through 24 nodes, each carrying one of 6 labels. Given a start node and a query label, walk to the FIRST node whose label equals the query and report WHICH NODE that is.
why_this_task: It is the decoupled control that QNEURO3-Q3-P1 specified and did not run. The answer is a node identity, not the hop count, so no model can score by reporting its own step count.
The goal is content-addressed rather than fixed, so its identity cannot be looked up in advance. An earlier version that fixed the goal at node 0 leaked completely and is preserved as FAIL-026.

shortcut_audit.reading: Any accuracy above about 0.30 requires actually walking the chain.

held_constant: Same recurrent core, same per-step inputs (state, successor read, label read, query, and the elementwise product carried*query), same normalisation.
AdamW 2e-3, 8 epochs, 500 batches of 128, grad-norm clip 1.0.
Per-step match supervision is given to EVERY model that has a per-step head, so supervision is not a confound.

results_at_max_depth_8.answer_read_from: final state, plus per-step match loss
final state, with an explicit learned latch
first step where the predicate fires

findings.finding: The separation is not about supervision. fixed_supervised receives exactly the per-step match supervision that select receives and still scores 0.232-0.243, below the 0.291 lookup baseline.
The separation is not about preservation. An explicit learned latch, initialised open so it can close on a detected match and carry the state unchanged, fails on 3 of 3 seeds at 0.222-0.239.

The separation is not simply gradient-path length. Mean pooling gives the answer gradient a one-hop path to every step, and reaches 0.847 on 1 seed of 3 while the other two sit at 0.26. Short credit assignment helps sporadically and is not sufficient.

Reading the answer from an INPUT-SELECTED step is what makes the computation reliably learnable. Both models that do so reach 1.0000 on every seed at every depth tested; every model that does not stays at or below the lookup baseline except one lucky pooling seed.

The readout location also decides whether the per-step head itself can learn. fixed_supervised and select receive an identical per-step match signal, yet select identifies the match step with accuracy 1.0000 while fixed_supervised manages 0.134-0.310. When the primary objective's gradient does not flow through a per-step state, that state does not become semantically well-formed, and a head reading it cannot learn either.

Halting is separable from attribution and is free. select and arrival are identical in accuracy at every depth; arrival additionally stops at the selected step, giving 2.51 / 4.45 / 6.55 mean steps against 4 / 8 / 12, a 1.59x / 1.80x / 1.83x compute reduction at identical accuracy.

The fixed-depth model has a sharp capability threshold between max_depth 4 (solves, 1.0000 / 0.8759) and max_depth 8 (fails, 0.22). The frozen carry-distance explanation for this was tested and is FALSE (QNEURO3-ATTRIB-P1). No mechanism is currently claimed for the threshold.

prior_art_position: Reading an answer by pointing at a position rather than regenerating it from a fixed-size summary is Pointer Networks (Vinyals et al. 2015) and the same argument underlies span-scoring readouts in extractive question answering. Selecting over positions is established and no novelty is claimed for it.

Per-step readouts combined with a halting distribution are PonderNet (Banino et al. 2021); adaptive computation time is Graves (2016); early-exit classifiers and deep supervision (Lee et al. 2015) supply per-step losses. None of these is claimed as novel here.

What is measured here and not found stated elsewhere: applying position-selection to a recurrence's OWN TIME AXIS, where the selected index and the halting step coincide, and the observation that an auxiliary per-step loss is NOT a substitute for routing the primary objective through the selected step (finding A5).
The prior-art comparison is a live obligation, not a settled one. Nothing in this record may be described as novel until that comparison is done against actual update equations.
open: A7: the max_depth 4-to-8 threshold for fixed-depth readout is unexplained.
Whether the ordering transfers to a qualitatively different task family. Frozen as QNEURO3-TRANSFER-P1 and tested separately.

Whether normalisation is required for arrival halting on this family too. Measured: unnormalised arrival gets 0.035 answer accuracy against 1.0000 normalised, consistent with QNEURO3-Q3-VARIANCE-001, but only 2 seeds.
